title: A factorial supersingular congruence and signed discriminant ratios: manuscript, code and data (v2.0)
description:
Manuscript (version 2.0) and supplementary packages for A factorial supersingular congruence and signed discriminant ratios. For every prime p ≥ 5, the paper proves the supersingular congruence E_{p+1}^{(p-1)/2} ≡ (6/p) ((p-1)/2)! Δ^{(p^2-1)/24} mod (p, E_{p-1}), which evaluates the half-power ratio uniformly on the supersingular locus and recovers Baker's congruence on squaring. Combined with Robert's isogeny identity, it shows that (Δ(τ)/Δ(ℓτ))^{(p^2-1)/24} = (ℓ/p) at every supersingular point of X_0(ℓ) for every prime ℓ ≠ p, determining the half-exponent sign in Ono's supersingular discriminant-ratio identity, and extends this to arbitrary prime-to-p isogenies.

Split from the combined manuscript archived as v1.11 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24024359) and v1.13 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24084789). The Fricke-Hauptmodul application is now the companion paper Supersingular poles and signed residues of prime-level Fricke Hauptmoduln (https://github.com/bbrhuft/fricke-signed-residues).

The archive contains the LaTeX source and PDF, exact-arithmetic verification code and timing benchmarks. Each supplementary package has its own README and SHA-256 manifest.

Status: preprint, not yet peer reviewed. AI-assisted (OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5). Code is MIT-licensed; the manuscript and notes are © 2026 David Jordan, all rights reserved, pending publication.
